notes: Free-mode test: POV of a father picking his daughter up from school. Tests voices on a 3-continuation chain and a new scene after a hard cut. No voice sample: H3 picks the voices.

homme.description: the man who holds the camera; he is never seen, except at most his hands and the sleeves of a dark wool coat entering the bottom of the frame

rue.description: The street, its pavement, shop fronts and light

clips.name: sortie_ecole

dialogue.speaker: fillette
dialogue.text: Papa ! Papa ! Regarde, j'ai eu une étoile à la dictée !

dialogue.speaker: homme
dialogue.text: Une étoile ? Fais voir ça, championne.

clips.summary: Point-of-view shot in the street: the girl runs up to the camera after school, waving a sheet of paper, and proudly announces her good mark.
clips.description:
The target video is a cinematic live-action scene shot as a first-person point of view: the camera is the eyes of a man standing at adult height, slight natural handheld sway, natural daylight, realistic skin texture, shallow depth of field, no on-screen text.
[Shot 1] The camera stands still on the pavement, looking along the street. @fillette runs towards the camera from the middle distance, a school bag bouncing on her back, waving a sheet of paper above her head. She stops right in front of the camera, out of breath, and looks up into the lens with a huge smile. @fillette (S), excited and breathless, says: <d>[French] Papa ! Papa ! Regarde, j'ai eu une étoile à la dictée !</d> She holds the sheet up towards the camera. After a short beat, @homme (S), off-screen, amused and warm, says: <d>[French] Une étoile ? Fais voir ça, championne.</d> The camera tilts down slightly towards the paper. End with a quiet half second: the girl still holding the sheet up, smiling, mouth closed. Setting: @rue.
clips.soundscape: Quiet city street after school: distant traffic, a few children's voices far away, footsteps on the pavement, light wind. The two voices are close and clear, the man's voice slightly closer to the microphone since he holds the camera.

clips.name: la_dictee

dialogue.speaker: homme
dialogue.text: Zéro faute... Tu as triché ou quoi ?

dialogue.speaker: fillette
dialogue.text: Mais non ! J'ai juste beaucoup révisé avec mamie.

clips.summary: Same unbroken point-of-view shot: the man takes the dictation sheet, reads it and teases the girl, who protests, laughing.
clips.description:
The target video is a cinematic live-action scene shot as a first-person point of view: the camera is the eyes of a man standing at adult height, slight natural handheld sway, natural daylight, realistic skin texture, shallow depth of field, no on-screen text.
[Shot 1] A man's hand in a dark wool coat sleeve enters the bottom of the frame and takes the sheet; the camera looks down at the handwritten dictation with a gold star sticker in the corner, then lifts back to the girl. @homme (S), off-screen, pretending to be suspicious, says: <d>[French] Zéro faute... Tu as triché ou quoi ?</d> @fillette puts her hands on her hips, outraged, then bursts out laughing. @fillette (S), laughing, says: <d>[French] Mais non ! J'ai juste beaucoup révisé avec mamie.</d> End with a quiet half second: she smiles up at the camera, mouth closed. Setting: @rue.
clips.soundscape: Quiet city street after school: distant traffic, a few children's voices far away, footsteps on the pavement, light wind. The two voices are close and clear, the man's voice slightly closer to the microphone since he holds the camera.

clips.name: le_plan

dialogue.speaker: fillette
dialogue.text: Dis, une étoile, ça mérite un pain au chocolat, non ?

dialogue.speaker: homme
dialogue.text: Ah, je vois... C'était donc ça, le plan.

clips.summary: Same unbroken point-of-view shot: they start walking side by side along the street and the girl slyly asks for a treat.
clips.description:
The target video is a cinematic live-action scene shot as a first-person point of view: the camera is the eyes of a man standing at adult height, slight natural handheld sway, natural daylight, realistic skin texture, shallow depth of field, no on-screen text.
[Shot 1] The camera starts walking slowly along the pavement; @fillette walks beside it on the right, the sheet now folded in her hand, looking up sideways at the camera with a sly smile. @fillette (S), innocently, says: <d>[French] Dis, une étoile, ça mérite un pain au chocolat, non ?</d> The camera turns slightly towards her. @homme (S), off-screen, with a knowing laugh, says: <d>[French] Ah, je vois... C'était donc ça, le plan.</d> End with a quiet half second of walking, both silent. Setting: @rue.
clips.soundscape: Quiet city street after school: distant traffic, a few children's voices far away, footsteps on the pavement, light wind. The two voices are close and clear, the man's voice slightly closer to the microphone since he holds the camera.

clips.name: s_il_te_plait

dialogue.speaker: fillette
dialogue.text: S'il te plaît, s'il te plaît, s'il te plaît !

clips.summary: Same unbroken point-of-view shot: the girl jumps in front of the camera and begs; the man gives in.
clips.description:
The target video is a cinematic live-action scene shot as a first-person point of view: the camera is the eyes of a man standing at adult height, slight natural handheld sway, natural daylight, realistic skin texture, shallow depth of field, no on-screen text.
[Shot 1] @fillette skips ahead, turns round to face the camera, walking backwards, and clasps her hands together under her chin, pleading with big eyes. @fillette (S), pleading in a sing-song voice, says: <d>[French] S'il te plaît, s'il te plaît, s'il te plaît !</d> The camera stops. @homme (S), off-screen, giving in with a sigh and a smile, says: <d>[French] Bon, d'accord. Mais un seul !</d> @fillette raises both fists in victory, silently. End with her spinning round to run ahead. Setting: @rue.
clips.soundscape: Quiet city street after school: distant traffic, a few children's voices far away, footsteps on the pavement, light wind. The two voices are close and clear, the man's voice slightly closer to the microphone since he holds the camera.

clips.name: la_vitrine

dialogue.speaker: fillette
dialogue.text: Celui-là ! Le plus gros, là, avec plein de chocolat !

clips.summary: A little later, further along the same street: point-of-view shot of the girl at a bakery window, choosing the biggest pastry.
clips.description:
The target video is a cinematic live-action scene shot as a first-person point of view: the camera is the eyes of a man standing at adult height, slight natural handheld sway, natural daylight, realistic skin texture, shallow depth of field, no on-screen text.
[Shot 1] Then @fillette presses both hands and her nose against the window full of pastries, turns her head to look up at the camera and points at a large chocolate pastry. @fillette (S), delighted, says: <d>[French] Celui-là ! Le plus gros, là, avec plein de chocolat !</d> @homme (S), off-screen, laughing, says: <d>[French] Un seul, j'ai dit !</d> She grins with a chocolate-hungry look. End on her grin, mouth closed, the shop sign reflected in the glass. Setting: @rue.
